name: three-view arm-normalized filtered voting@96
objective: Reuse the frozen T10d arms and T8-3 filter, normalize each arm's surviving valid answer histogram to total mass one, and sum the three arm distributions without new generation or training.
status_before_execution: post-hoc exploratory reaggregation requested after T10d; freeze the exact rule before evaluating labels or producing the leaderboard submission

aggregation.per_arm_filter_and_fallback: reuse T10d/T8-3 byte-frozen selection independently for each arm
aggregation.per_arm_denominator: number of valid extracted integer answers remaining after filter and per-arm fallback
aggregation.answer_score: sum over arms of count_arm(answer) / valid_votes_arm
aggregation.tie_break: first valid generated answer in arm_order then sample_index order

evaluation.incremental_reference: T10d three-view flat filtered majority@96 on the identical candidate pools
evaluation.interpretation: Exploratory because arm normalization was proposed after prior holdout results were known. Passing the numerical T8 gate does not constitute independent confirmatory adoption; the incremental comparison against T10d must be reported separately.

regulatory_note.classification: same-base local multi-sampling plus answer-string distribution aggregation; no arithmetic or semantic verifier
regulatory_note.remaining_uncertainty: Retain T10d's request for written organizer confirmation of the 96-sample composition and extraction-path/termination-based vote exclusion; also confirm that per-arm answer-frequency normalization is accepted as majority-vote post-processing.
